events.summary: UCDP records a civil conflict between Government of Egypt and Harakit Sawa'id Misr, Jama'at Ansar al-Islam over control of the government, starting 2017-07-14. This episode was active in 3 years (2017–2019), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year), and ended 2019-09-24.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: DR Congo (Zaire) vs BDK (Kongo Kingdom)
events.summary: UCDP records an internationalised civil conflict between Government of DR Congo (Zaire) (backed by Government of Malawi, Government of South Africa, Government of Tanzania) and BDK over control of Kongo Kingdom, starting 2017-08-07. This episode was active in 1 year (2017–2017), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year), and ended 2017-08-31.

events.title: Terrorist attack: Charlottesville car attack
events.summary: The Charlottesville car attack was a white supremacist terrorist attack perpetrated on August 12, 2017, when James Alex Fields Jr. deliberately drove his car into a crowd of people protesting the Unite the Right rally in Charlottesville, Virginia, killing one person and injuring 35.

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2017 Catalonia attacks
events.summary: On the afternoon of 17 August 2017, 22-year-old Younes Abouyaaqoub drove a van into a crowd of pedestrians on La Rambla street in Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain, killing 13 people and injuring at least 130 others, one of whom died as a result of the injuries ten days later, on 27 August.

events.title: Natural disaster: Hurricane Harvey
events.summary: Hurricane Harvey was a powerful and catastrophic tropical cyclone that made landfall in Texas and Louisiana in August 2017, causing widespread flooding and more than 100 deaths.

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2017 Turku attack
events.summary: On 18 August 2017, a mass stabbing took place in Turku, Finland. Two women were killed and eight others were injured before the perpetrator, 22-year-old Abderrahman Bouanane, was detained. Boaunane, a Moroccan rejected asylum seeker, had been using the alias Abderrahman Mechkah, which was later discovered to be a false identity.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Lebanon vs IS (Islamic State)
events.summary: UCDP records a civil conflict between Government of Lebanon and IS over control of Islamic State, starting 2017-08-19. This episode was active in 1 year (2017–2017), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year), and ended 2017-08-27.

events.title: Natural disaster: Hurricane Irma
events.summary: Hurricane Irma was an extremely powerful and devastating tropical cyclone that caused extensive damage and multiple deaths across the Antilles and Eastern United States in September 2017.

events.title: Earthquake: 2017 Oaxaca and Chiapas Earthquake
events.summary: The 2017 Chiapas earthquake struck at 23:49 CDT on 7 September in the Gulf of Tehuantepec off the southern coast of Mexico near the state of Chiapas, approximately 87 kilometres (54 mi) southwest of Pijijiapan, with a Mercalli intensity of IX (Violent). The moment magnitude was estimated to be Mw 8.2.

events.title: Ramush Haradinaj takes power
events.summary: Ramush Haradinaj is a Kosovar politician who served as prime minister of Kosovo from 2004 to 2005 and from 2017 to 2020. He was the leader of the AAK party from its founding in 2000 until May 2026, and is a former officer and leader of the Kosovo Liberation Army (KLA).

events.title: 2017 Krasnodar Krai Legislative Assembly election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Krasnodar Krai on 10 September 2017. After the previous elections in 2012, United Russia was the largest party in the Legislative Assembly with 95 seats.

events.title: 2017 Norwegian parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Norway on 11 September 2017 to elect all 169 members of the unicameral Norwegian Parliament, the Storting. The non-socialist parties retained a reduced majority of 88 seats, allowing Prime Minister Erna Solberg's Conservative-Progress coalition to remain in government.

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2017 Parsons Green bombing
events.summary: On 15 September 2017, at around 08:20 BST, an explosion occurred on a District line train at Parsons Green Underground station, in London, England.

events.title: Natural disaster: Hurricane Maria
events.summary: Hurricane Maria was an extremely powerful and catastrophic tropical cyclone that affected the northeastern Caribbean in September 2017, particularly in the U.S. territory of Puerto Rico, which accounted for 2,975 of the 3,059 deaths.

events.title: Earthquake: 2017 Central Mexico earthquake
events.summary: The 2017 Puebla earthquake, also known as 19S, struck at 13:14 CDT on 19 September 2017 with an estimated magnitude of 7.1 Mw and strong shaking for about 20 seconds. Its epicenter was about 55 km (34 mi) south of the city of Puebla, Mexico.

events.title: Treaty signed: Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons
events.summary: The Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons (TPNW), or the Nuclear Weapon Ban Treaty, is the first legally binding international agreement to comprehensively prohibit nuclear weapons, with the ultimate goal being their total elimination. It was adopted on 7 July 2017, opened for signature on 20 September 2017, and entered into force on 22 January 2021.

events.title: 2017 French Senate election
events.summary: Senatorial elections were held on 24 September 2017 to renew 170 of 348 seats in the Senate of the French Fifth Republic.

events.title: 2017 Slovenian railway referendum
events.summary: A referendum on a law governing the Divača-Koper rail upgrade was held in Slovenia on 24 September 2017. The referendum was marked by a low turnout; a majority of voters voted in favour of the proposed law. The results were annulled by the Supreme Court in March 2018, resulting in a new referendum being held on 13 May 2018.

events.title: 2017 German federal election
events.summary: A federal election was held in Germany on 24 September 2017 to elect the members of the 19th Bundestag. At stake were at least 598 seats in the Bundestag, as well as 111 overhang and leveling seats determined thereafter.

events.title: Terrorist attack: October 2017 Mogadishu bombings
events.summary: On 14 October 2017, two truck bombings took place in Mogadishu, the capital of Somalia, killing at least 587 people and injuring 316 others.

events.title: 2017 Austrian legislative election
events.summary: Legislative elections were held in Austria on 15 October 2017 to elect the 26th National Council, the lower house of Austria's bicameral parliament.

events.title: Battle: Battle of Kirkuk
events.summary: The Battle of Kirkuk, codenamed Operation Enforcing Security of the 2017 Iraqi–Kurdish conflict, was a military deployment by the Iraqi Security Forces to retake Kirkuk Governorate from the Peshmerga after the latter ignored repeated warnings to withdraw, sparking clashes between the two forces.

events.title: 2017 Czech parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in the Czech Republic on 20 and 21 October 2017. All 200 members of the Chamber of Deputies were elected and Andrej Babiš of ANO, also the leader of the resultant government, became the Prime Minister.

events.title: 2017 Lombard autonomy referendum
events.summary: The 2017 Lombard autonomy referendum took place on 22 October in Lombardy, Italy.

events.title: 2017 Venetian autonomy referendum
events.summary: The Venetian autonomy referendum of 2017 took place on 22 October in Veneto, Italy.

events.title: 2017 Icelandic parliamentary election
events.summary: Early parliamentary elections were held in Iceland on 28 October 2017. On 15 September 2017, the three-party coalition government collapsed after the departure of Bright Future over a scandal involving Prime Minister Bjarni Benediktsson's father writing a letter recommending a convicted child sex offender have his "honour restored".

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2017 Lower Manhattan attack
events.summary: On October 31, 2017, Sayfullo Habibullaevic Saipov drove a rented pickup truck into cyclists and runners for about one mile of the Hudson River Park's bike path alongside West Street from Houston Street south to Chambers Street in Lower Manhattan, New York City.

events.title: Earthquake: 2017 Iran–Iraq earthquake
events.summary: On 12 November 2017 at 18:18 UTC, an earthquake with a moment magnitude of 7.4 occurred on the Iran–Iraq border, with the Iraqi Kurdish city of Halabja, and the Kurdish dominated places of Ezgeleh, Salas-e Babajani County, Kermanshah province in Iran, closest to the epicentre, 30 kilometres (19 mi) south of the city of Halabja, Iraqi Kurdistan.

events.title: 2017 Slovenian presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in Slovenia on 22 October 2017. Nine candidates ran in the first round of the elections, in which the incumbent independent President Borut Pahor placed first and Marjan Šarec of the List of Marjan Šarec (LMŠ) placed second.

events.title: Coup: 2017 Zimbabwean coup d'état attempt
events.summary: The 2017 Zimbabwean coup d'état was a bloodless military coup that took place in Zimbabwe on 14 to 21 November 2017, when Zimbabwean president Robert Mugabe was removed as president and party leader of ZANU–PF and was replaced by Emmerson Mnangagwa.

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2017 Sinai mosque attack
events.summary: At 1:50 PM EET on 24 November 2017, the al-Rawda mosque was attacked by roughly 40 gunmen during Friday prayers. The mosque is located in the village of Al-Rawda east of the town of Bir al-Abed in Egypt's North Sinai Governorate. It is one of the main mosques associated with the Jaririya Sufi order, one of the largest Sufi orders in North Sinai.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Central African Republic vs anti-Balaka
events.summary: UCDP records an internationalised civil conflict between Government of Central African Republic (backed by Government of Bangladesh, Government of Benin, Government of Burkina Faso, Government of Burundi, Government of Cambodia (Kampuchea), Government of Cameroon, Government of Congo, Government of Djibouti, Government of DR Congo (Zaire), Government of Egypt, Government of France, Government of Gabon, Government of Gambia, Government of Ghana, Government of Guinea, Government of Hungary, Government of Indonesia, Government of Ivory Coast, Government of Jordan, Government of Mali, Government of Mauritania, Government of Morocco, Government of Nepal, Government of Niger, Government of Pakistan, Government of Peru, Government of Portugal, Government of Romania, Government of Rwanda, Government of Senegal, Government of Serbia (Yugoslavia), Government of Spain, Government of Sri Lanka, Government of Sweden, Government of Tanzania, Government of Togo, Government of Tunisia, Government of Yemen (North Yemen), Government of Zambia) and anti-Balaka over control of the government, starting 2017-11-26. This episode was active in 9 years (2017–2025), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year) and was still active in the latest data.

events.title: Katrín Jakobsdóttir takes power
events.summary: Katrín Jakobsdóttir is an Icelandic former politician who served as the prime minister of Iceland from December 2017 to April 2024, and was a member of the Althing for the Reykjavík North constituency from 2007 to 2024.

events.title: Andrej Babiš takes power
events.summary: Andrej Babiš is a Czech politician and businessman who has been the prime minister of the Czech Republic since December 2025, having previously served as prime minister from 2017 to 2021. Prior to that, he was the minister of finance and deputy prime minister from 2014 to 2017.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Cameroon vs Ambazonia insurgents (Ambazonia)
events.summary: UCDP records a civil conflict between Government of Cameroon and Ambazonia insurgents over control of Ambazonia, starting 2017-12-08. This episode was active in 9 years (2017–2025), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year) and was still active in the latest data.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: DR Congo (Zaire) vs IS (Islamic State)
events.summary: UCDP records an internationalised civil conflict between Government of DR Congo (Zaire) (backed by Government of Malawi, Government of South Africa, Government of Tanzania) and IS over control of Islamic State, starting 2017-12-08. This episode was active in 9 years (2017–2025), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year) and was still active in the latest data.

events.title: Sebastian Kurz takes power
events.summary: Sebastian Kurz is an Austrian former politician who served twice as Chancellor of Austria, first from 2017 to 2019 and then again from 2020 to 2021.

events.title: 2017 Nevis Island Assembly election
events.summary: Island Assembly elections were held in Nevis on 18 December 2017 to elect five members of the Nevis Island Assembly.

events.title: 2018 Trinidad and Tobago presidential election
events.summary: Indirect presidential elections were held in Trinidad and Tobago on 19 January 2018.

events.title: Battle: Turkish military operation in Afrin
events.summary: Operation Olive Branch was an invasion by the Turkish Armed Forces and Syrian National Army (SNA) in the Kurdish-majority Afrin District of northwest Syria, against the People's Protection Units (YPG) of the Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF).

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2018 Kabul ambulance bombing
events.summary: On 27 January 2018, an ambulance was used as a vehicle-borne improvised explosive device near Sidarat Square in Kabul, Afghanistan. At least 103 people were killed and 235 others wounded in the attack. The Taliban claimed responsibility for the attack.

events.title: 2018 Czech presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in the Czech Republic in January 2018. The first round took place on 12 and 13 January. As no candidate won a majority, a run-off election between the top two candidates, Jiří Drahoš and President Miloš Zeman, was held on 26 and 27 January 2018.

events.title: 2018 Finnish presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in Finland on 28 January 2018. The incumbent Sauli Niinistö received 63% of the vote and was re-elected for a second term, avoiding a second round. He received a plurality of the vote in every municipality and a majority in all but 13 municipalities.

events.title: 2018 Cypriot presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in Cyprus on 28 January 2018. As no candidate received a majority of the vote in the first round, a run-off was held on 4 February between the top two candidates, incumbent President Nicos Anastasiades of the Democratic Rally (DISY) and Stavros Malas of the Progressive Party of Working People.

events.title: Earthquake: 2018 Hualien earthquake
events.summary: At 23:50 (UTC+8) on 6 February 2018, an earthquake of magnitude 6.4 on the moment magnitude scale hit Taiwan. The epicenter was on the coastline near Hualien, which was the most severely affected area, with a maximum felt intensity of 7 on the Central Weather Administration seismic intensity scale. At least 17 deaths were reported, with 285 injured.

events.title: Battle: Battle of Khasham
events.summary: The Battle of Khasham, also known as the Battle of Conoco Fields, was a military engagement of the Syrian civil war fought on 7 February 2018 near the towns of Khasham and Al Tabiyeh in the Deir ez-Zor Governorate, Syria.

events.title: 2018 Monegasque general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Monaco on 11 February 2018. Since the General Election of 2013, the largest party, Horizon Monaco, split, which led to the formation of a new political party – Primo! Priorite Monaco. The latter won 58% of the vote, while the other parties, Horizon Monaco and Union Monégasque got 26% and 16% respectively.

events.title: 2018 Armenian presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in Armenia on 2 March 2018. As a result of the 2015 Armenian constitutional referendum, this was the first time in Armenia's history when the president was elected by the National Assembly instead of popular vote.

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2018 Ouagadougou attack
events.summary: On 2 March 2018, at least eight heavily armed militants launched an assault on key locations throughout Ouagadougou, the capital city of Burkina Faso. Targets included the French embassy and the headquarters of Burkina Faso's military.

events.title: 2018 Salvadoran legislative election
events.summary: Legislative elections were held in El Salvador on 4 March 2018 to choose 84 members of the Legislative Assembly and 262 mayors. The elections were carried out by the Supreme Electoral Tribunal.

events.title: Treaty signed: Escazu Agreement
events.summary: The Regional Agreement on Access to Information, Public Participation and Justice in Environmental Matters in Latin America and the Caribbean, better known as the Escazú Agreement, is an international treaty signed by 24 Latin American and Caribbean nations concerning the rights of access to information about the environment, public participation in…

events.title: 2018 Italian general election
events.summary: The 2018 Italian general election was held on 4 March 2018 after the Italian Parliament was dissolved by President Sergio Mattarella on 28 December 2017. Voters were electing the 630 members of the Chamber of Deputies and the 315 elective members of the Senate of the Republic for the 18th legislature of the Italian Republic since 1948.

events.title: Treaty signed: Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership
events.summary: The Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP), previously proposed as the TPP11 is a multilateral trade agreement that consists of twelve members states, spans over five continents and covers nearly 600 million people.

events.title: 2018 Cuban parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Cuba on 11 March 2018 to elect members of the National Assembly of People's Power. Prior to the elections, President Raúl Castro declared he would not be seeking a new term, and a new President of the Council of State will be elected by the National Assembly.

events.title: 2018 Grenadian general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Grenada on 13 March 2018. The result was a victory for the New National Party and incumbent Prime Minister Keith Mitchell, winning his fifth term in office.

events.title: Assassination: assassination of Marielle Franco
events.summary: Marielle Franco, a Brazilian politician and activist, was fatally shot on 14 March 2018, in Estácio, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The assassins were in a car that pulled up alongside the Rio de Janeiro councilwoman's car and fired several shots, which also killed the driver, Anderson Gomes.

events.title: 2018 Russian presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in Russia on 18 March 2018. Incumbent president Vladimir Putin was eligible to run. He declared his intent to do so on 6 December 2017 and was expected to win.

events.title: 2018 Antiguan general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Antigua and Barbuda on 21 March 2018 to elect members to House of Representatives of the 15th Antigua and Barbuda Parliament. Each of the 17 constituencies elected one Member of Parliament (MP).

events.title: 2018 Dutch Intelligence and Security Services Act referendum
events.summary: An advisory referendum on the Intelligence and Security Services Act 2017 was held in the Netherlands on 21 March 2018, alongside the municipal elections. It was the second referendum to be held under the Dutch Advisory Referendum Act after the 2016 Ukraine–European Union Association Agreement referendum.

events.title: Peter Pellegrini takes power
events.summary: Peter Pellegrini is a Slovak politician who has been serving since 2024 as the sixth president of Slovakia. He previously served as prime minister of Slovakia from 2018 to 2020.

events.title: Terrorist attack: Carcassonne and Trèbes attack
events.summary: On 23 March 2018, an Islamic terrorist carried out three attacks in the town of Carcassonne and the nearby village of Trèbes in the Aude department in southwestern France, killing four people and injuring fifteen.

events.title: 2018 Hungarian parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Hungary on 8 April 2018. The elections were the second since the adoption of a new constitution, which came into force on 1 January 2012.

events.title: 2018 Azerbaijani presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in Azerbaijan on 11 April 2018. The elections were the first since the 2016 constitutional referendum, which extended the presidential term from five to seven years. The incumbent, Ilham Aliyev, was re-elected president for a seven-year term.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Israel vs Hamas (Palestine)
events.summary: UCDP records a civil conflict between Government of Israel and Hamas over control of Palestine, starting 2018-04-12. This episode was active in 2 years (2018–2019), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year), and ended 2019-11-14.

events.title: 2018 Guatemalan territorial dispute referendum
events.summary: A referendum on the territorial dispute with Belize was held in Guatemala on Sunday 15 April 2018. Voters were asked whether the Guatemalan government should request the International Court of Justice to resolve the territorial dispute permanently, as part of a commitment signed in December 2008 between Guatemala and Belize.

events.title: 2018 Montenegrin presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in Montenegro on 15 April 2018. Former Prime Minister Milo Đukanović, leader of the ruling DPS was elected as new President of Montenegro in the first round.

events.title: Miguel Díaz-Canel takes power
events.summary: Miguel Díaz-Canel Bermúdez is a Cuban politician and engineer who has served as the 8th first secretary of the Communist Party of Cuba and the leader of Cuba since 2021. In 2019 he became the 17th president of Cuba and was president of the Council of State from 2018 until 2019.

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2018 Toronto van attack
events.summary: On April 23, 2018, a vehicle-ramming attack occurred when a rented van was driven along Yonge Street through the North York City Centre business district in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. The driver, 25-year-old Alek Minassian, targeted pedestrians, killing 11 and injuring 15, some critically.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Iran – Israel
events.summary: UCDP records an interstate conflict between Government of Iran and Government of Israel over control of the government, starting 2018-04-29. This episode was active in 8 years (2018–2025), 1 of them at war level (1,000+ battle deaths a year) and was still active in the latest data.

events.title: Nikol Pashinyan takes power
events.summary: Nikol Vovayi Pashinyan is an Armenian politician who has served as the 16th and current prime minister of Armenia since 2018. A journalist by profession, Pashinyan founded his own newspaper in 1998, which was shut down a year later for libel. He was sentenced for one year for defamation against then Minister of National Security Serzh Sargsyan.

events.title: Carlos Alvarado Quesada takes power
events.summary: Carlos Andrés Alvarado Quesada is a Costa Rican politician, writer, journalist, and political scientist who served as the 48th president of Costa Rica from 8 May 2018 to 8 May 2022. A member of the Citizens' Action Party (PAC), he previously served as Minister of Labor and Social Security under President Luis Guillermo Solís.

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2018 Paris knife attack
events.summary: On 12 May 2018, a 20-year-old Chechnya-born French citizen, armed with a knife, killed one pedestrian and injured four others near the Palais Garnier opera house in Paris, France, before being fatally shot by police. The stabbings were in the area of Rue Saint-Augustin and Passage Choiseul.

events.title: 2018 Slovenian railway referendum
events.summary: A referendum on a law governing the Divača-Koper rail upgrade was held in Slovenia on 13 May 2018. It followed the annulment of the results of a 2017 referendum on the same subject by the Supreme Court in March 2018. The result saw just 309 more votes cast against the law (50.06%) than in favour (49.94%).

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Somalia vs Republic of Somaliland (Somaliland)
events.summary: UCDP records a civil conflict between Government of Somalia and Republic of Somaliland over control of Somaliland, starting 2018-05-15. This episode was active in 1 year (2018–2018), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year), and ended 2018-11-05.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Burkina Faso vs JNIM
events.summary: UCDP records an internationalised civil conflict between Government of Burkina Faso (backed by Government of Mali) and JNIM over control of the government, starting 2018-05-22. This episode was active in 8 years (2018–2025), 4 of them at war level (1,000+ battle deaths a year) and was still active in the latest data.

events.title: 2018 Barbadian general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Barbados on 24 May 2018. The result was a landslide victory for the opposition Barbados Labour Party (BLP), which won all 30 seats in the House of Assembly, resulting in BLP leader Mia Mottley becoming the country's first female prime minister.

events.title: Mia Mottley takes power
events.summary: Mia Amor Mottley is a Barbadian politician and lawyer who has served as the eighth prime minister of Barbados since 2018 and as Leader of the Barbados Labour Party (BLP) since 2008. Mottley is the first woman to hold both positions. Having overseen the abolition of the Barbadian monarchy, she is the first prime minister of the Barbadian republic.

events.title: 2018 Irish abortion referendum
events.summary: The Thirty-sixth Amendment of the Constitution of Ireland is an amendment to the Constitution of Ireland which permits the Oireachtas to legislate for abortion. The constitution had previously prohibited abortion, unless there was a serious risk to the life of the mother.

events.title: Giuseppe Conte takes power
events.summary: Giuseppe Conte is an Italian jurist, academic, and politician who served as prime minister of Italy from June 2018 to February 2021. He has been the president of the Five Star Movement (M5S) since August 2021.

events.title: Pedro Sánchez takes power
events.summary: Pedro Sánchez Pérez-Castejón is a Spanish politician who has been the prime minister of Spain since 2018. A member of the Spanish Socialist Workers' Party (PSOE), he is also Secretary-General of the party since 2017, having previously held that office from 2014 to 2016, and is the ninth president of Socialist International since 2022.

events.title: 2018 Slovenian parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Slovenia on 3 June 2018. The elections were originally expected to be held later in June 2018, but after the resignation of Prime Minister Miro Cerar on 14 March 2018 all parties called for snap elections. They were the third consecutive snap elections after 2011 and 2014.

events.title: 2018 Czech Social Democratic Party government referendum
events.summary: From 21 May 2018 to 14 June 2018 the Czech Social Democratic Party (ČSSD) held a referendum to determine whether it should join the minority government of Andrej Babiš with potential confidence and supply from the Communist Party.

events.title: Treaty signed: Prespa agreement
events.summary: The Prespa Agreement, also known as the Treaty of Prespa, the Prespes deal or the Prespa accord, is an agreement reached in 2018 between Greece and the then-Republic of Macedonia, under the auspices of the United Nations, resolving a long-standing naming dispute between the two countries.

events.title: Earthquake: 2018 Osaka earthquake
events.summary: On 18 June 2018, around 7:58:35 a.m. Japan Standard Time, an earthquake measuring 5.6 Mw on the moment magnitude scale struck in northern Osaka Prefecture, Japan. The earthquake's epicenter was near Takatsuki and occurred at a depth of approximately 10.3 kilometres (6.4 mi).

events.title: Mamuka Bakhtadze takes power
events.summary: Mamuka Bakhtadze is a Georgian politician who served as the country's prime minister from 20 June 2018 until 2 September 2019. Bakhtadze announced his official statement about resignation via Facebook post. He had previously served as minister of finance (2017–2018) and, prior to that, executive director of the Georgian Railway company (2013–2017).

events.title: Recep Tayyip Erdoğan takes power
events.summary: Recep Tayyip Erdoğan is a Turkish politician who has been the president of Turkey since 2014. He previously served as the 25th prime minister from 2003 to 2014 as part of the Justice and Development Party (AKP), which he co-founded in 2001. He also served as mayor of Istanbul from 1994 to 1998.

events.title: 2018 Turkish presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in Turkey on 24 June 2018 as part of the 2018 general election, alongside parliamentary elections on the same day. They were the first presidential elections held after constitutional amendments were approved in a 2017 referendum.

events.title: 2018 Turkish parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Turkey on 24 June 2018 as part of general elections, with presidential elections taking place on the same day. Originally scheduled for 27 October 2019, President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan called snap elections on 18 April after months of speculation.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Mozambique vs ASWJ
events.summary: UCDP records a civil conflict between Government of Mozambique and ASWJ over control of the government, starting 2018-07-10. This episode was active in 2 years (2018–2019), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year), and ended 2019-07-12.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Iran vs PJAK
events.summary: UCDP records a civil conflict between Government of Iran and PJAK over control of the government, starting 2018-07-20. This episode was active in 4 years (2018–2021), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year), and ended 2021-08-06.

events.title: Epidemic: 2018–2020 Kivu Ebola epidemic
events.summary: The Kivu Ebola epidemic was an outbreak of Ebola virus disease (EVD) mainly in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), and in other parts of Central Africa, from 2018 to 2020. Between 1 August 2018 and 25 June 2020 it resulted in 3,470 reported cases. The Kivu outbreak also affected Ituri Province, whose first case was confirmed on 13 August 2018.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Chad vs CCMSR
events.summary: UCDP records a civil conflict between Government of Chad and CCMSR over control of the government, starting 2018-08-11. This episode was active in 1 year (2018–2018), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year), and ended 2018-09-13.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Iran vs KDPI (Kurdistan)
events.summary: UCDP records a civil conflict between Government of Iran and KDPI over control of Kurdistan, starting 2018-08-11. This episode was active in 1 year (2018–2018), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year), and ended 2018-10-12.

events.title: Syarhei Rumas takes power
events.summary: Sergei Nikolayevich Rumas is a Belarusian politician and economist who served as Prime Minister of Belarus from August 2018 to June 2020.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Syria vs SDF (Rojava Kurdistan)
events.summary: UCDP records a civil conflict between Government of Syria and SDF over territory and government, starting 2018-09-08. This episode was active in 1 year (2018–2018), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year), and ended 2018-12-23.

events.title: 2018 Swedish general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Sweden on 9 September 2018 to elect the 349 members of the Riksdag. Regional and municipal elections were also held on the same day.

events.title: Marjan Šarec takes power
events.summary: Marjan Šarec is a Slovenian politician, actor and comedian who served as Prime Minister of Slovenia from 2018 to 2020. He also served as the Minister of Defence in the government of Prime Minister Robert Golob from June 2022 to July 2024 when he was elected to the European Parliament.

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2018 Ahvaz military parade attack
events.summary: On 22 September 2018, a military parade was attacked by gunmen in the southwestern Iranian city of Ahvaz. The shooters killed 25 people, including soldiers of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) and civilian bystanders. It was the deadliest terrorist attack in Iran since the Chabahar suicide bombing in December 2010.

events.title: Earthquake: 2018 Sulawesi earthquake and tsunami
events.summary: On 28 September 2018, a shallow, large earthquake struck in the neck of the Minahasa Peninsula, Indonesia, with its epicentre located in the mountainous Donggala Regency, Central Sulawesi.

events.title: 2018 Macedonian referendum
events.summary: A referendum was held in the Republic of Macedonia on 30 September 2018, with voters asked whether they supported EU and NATO membership by accepting the Prespa Agreement between Macedonia and Greece, signed in June 2018, which aimed to settle the 27-year naming dispute, which had prevented Macedonia from joining both the European Union and NATO.

events.title: 2018 Dominican presidential election
events.summary: An indirect presidential election was held on 1 October 2023 to elect the next President of Dominica. Incumbent President Charles Savarin was re-elected.

events.title: Assassination: assassination of Jamal Khashoggi
events.summary: On 2 October 2018, Jamal Khashoggi, a Saudi dissident journalist, was killed by agents of the Saudi government at the Saudi consulate in Istanbul, Turkey. Khashoggi was ambushed and strangled by a 15-member squad of Saudi operatives. His body was dismembered and disposed of in a manner that was never publicly revealed.

events.title: 2018 Latvian parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Latvia on 6 October 2018. Following the elections, a coalition government was formed by Who owns the state?, the New Conservative Party, Development/For!, the National Alliance and New Unity.

events.title: 2018 Romanian constitutional referendum
events.summary: A referendum took place in Romania on 6 and 7 October 2018 regarding the definition of the family in the Romanian Constitution. The referendum asked voters whether or not they approve a change to the family's definition as provided by Article 48 of the Constitution, to prohibit same-sex marriage.

events.title: Natural disaster: Hurricane Michael
events.summary: Hurricane Michael was a powerful and destructive tropical cyclone that became the first Category 5 hurricane to make landfall in the contiguous United States since Andrew in 1992.

events.title: 2018 Luxembourg general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Luxembourg on 14 October 2018. All 60 seats of the Chamber of Deputies were renewed.

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2018 United States mail bombing attempts
events.summary: From October 22 to November 1, 2018, 16 packages found to contain pipe bombs were mailed via the U.S. Postal Service to several Democratic Party politicians and other prominent critics of U.S. President Donald Trump. Targets included former U.S. President Barack Obama, former U.S. Vice President Joe Biden, and former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton.

events.title: Thirty-seventh Amendment of the Constitution of Ireland
events.summary: The Thirty-seventh Amendment of the Constitution is an amendment to the constitution of Ireland which removed the constitution's requirement to criminalise "publication or utterance of blasphemous matter".

events.title: 2018 Irish presidential election
events.summary: The 2018 Irish presidential election took place on Friday, 26 October, between 7.00 a.m. and 10.00 p.m. President Michael D. Higgins, who was elected in 2011 with the support of the Labour Party, was seeking re-election to a second term as an independent.

events.title: 2018 Antiguan constitutional referendum
events.summary: A constitutional referendum was held in Antigua and Barbuda on 6 November 2018, the first referendum in the country's history. The proposed constitutional amendment, which ultimately failed to pass, would have made the Caribbean Court of Justice the final court of appeal, replacing the London-based Judicial Committee of the Privy Council.

events.title: 2018 Grenadian constitutional referendum
events.summary: A constitutional referendum was held in Grenada on 6 November 2018. The proposed constitutional amendment, which voters ultimately rejected, would have made the Caribbean Court of Justice (CCJ) the final court of appeal, replacing the British Judicial Committee of the Privy Council, and renamed the Supreme Court.

events.title: 2018 Navajo Nation presidential election
events.summary: The Navajo Nation presidential election of 2018 was held on Tuesday, November 6, 2018. The candidates for President of the Navajo Nation in the general election were Jonathan Nez and Joe Shirley, Jr. Jonathan Nez and running mate Myron Lizer won the election.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Tajikistan vs IS (Islamic State)
events.summary: UCDP records a civil conflict between Government of Tajikistan and IS over control of Islamic State, starting 2018-11-08. This episode was active in 2 years (2018–2019), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year), and ended 2019-11-06.

events.title: 2018 Liechtenstein Tour de Ski referendum
events.summary: A referendum on the financing of the Tour de Ski was held in Liechtenstein on 25 November 2018. The proposal was rejected by 59% of voters.

events.title: 2018 Georgian presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in Georgia on 28 October 2018. As no candidate received more than 50% of the vote in the first round, a runoff between Salome Zourabichvili and Grigol Vashadze was held on 28 November 2018. Salome Zourabichvili won with around 60% of the vote in the second round and took office on 16 December 2018.

events.title: Treaty signed: United States–Mexico–Canada Agreement
events.summary: The Agreement between the United States of America, the United Mexican States, and Canada (USMCA) is a free trade agreement among the United States, Mexico, and Canada, in effect from July 1, 2020. It replaced the North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA) implemented in 1994.

events.title: 2018 Alderney general election
events.summary: The 2018 Alderney general election was held on 1 December 2018 to elect 5 members of the States of Alderney who will serve until 2022.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Indonesia vs OPM (West Papua)
events.summary: UCDP records a civil conflict between Government of Indonesia and OPM over control of West Papua, starting 2018-12-02. This episode was active in 8 years (2018–2025), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year) and was still active in the latest data.

events.title: 2018 Armenian parliamentary election
events.summary: Snap parliamentary elections were held in Armenia on 9 December 2018, as none of the parties in the National Assembly were able to put forward and then elect a candidate for Prime Minister in the two-week period following the resignation of incumbent Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan on 16 October.

events.title: Treaty signed: Global Compact on Migration
events.summary: The Global Compact for Safe, Orderly and Regular Migration (GCM) is an intergovernmentally negotiated agreement, prepared under the auspices of the United Nations, that describes itself as covering "all dimensions of international migration in a holistic and comprehensive manner".

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2018 Strasbourg attack
events.summary: On the evening of 11 December 2018, a terrorist attack occurred in Strasbourg, France, when a man attacked civilians in the city's busy Christkindelsmärik with a revolver and a knife, killing five and wounding 11 before fleeing in a taxi. Authorities called the shooting an act of terrorism.

events.title: Natural disaster: 2018 Sunda Strait tsunami
events.summary: The 2018 Sunda Strait tsunami occurred on 22 December 2018 at around 21:38 local time after large parts of the southwestern side of Anak Krakatoa collapsed onto its caldera. The landslide spawned a tsunami wave that struck multiple coastal regions in Banten and Lampung, including the tourist destination of Anyer.

events.title: Coup: 2019 Gabonese coup d'etat attempt
events.summary: On 7 January 2019, members of the Armed Forces of Gabon announced a coup d'état in Gabon. Military officers claimed that they had ousted President Ali Bongo, who was re-elected in 2016 after a controversial election and protests.

events.title: Assassination: assassination of Paweł Adamowicz
events.summary: Paweł Adamowicz, the mayor of Gdańsk, Poland, was fatally stabbed on 13 January 2019 while onstage during a local public event marking the 27th finale of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity, a nationwide Polish charity fundraiser, which was taking place in the city's Targ Węglowy square.

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2019 Nairobi attack
events.summary: On January 15, 2019, a coordinated attack perpetrated by non-state militants occurred at the DusitD2 complex in Westlands District, Nairobi, Kenya. The attack began at around 14:30 EAT (UTC+3), shortly after a suicide bomber blew himself up near the centre of the complex at a restaurant.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Burundi vs RED-TABARA
events.summary: UCDP records an internationalised civil conflict between Government of Burundi (backed by Government of DR Congo (Zaire)) and RED-TABARA  over control of the government, starting 2019-01-20. This episode was active in 6 years (2019–2024), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year), and ended 2024-12-11.

events.title: Terrorist attack: Maidan Shar attack
events.summary: On 21 January 2019, in central Afghanistan, the Taliban attacked a military compound in Maidan Shar, killing officers of the Afghan National Directorate of Security. The Taliban attacked while engaging in the process of negotiating a truce with the United States.

events.title: Treaty signed: Treaty of Aachen
events.summary: The Aachen Treaty, formally Treaty on Franco-German Cooperation and Integration, and also known as the Treaty of Aachen, is a bilateral agreement between Germany and France concerning mutual cooperation across major subjects, which entered into force on 22 January 2020, a year after it was signed.

events.title: Krišjānis Kariņš takes power
events.summary: Arturs Krišjānis Kariņš is a Latvian and American politician who served as the prime minister of Latvia from 2019 until 2023. A linguist and businessman by profession, he previously served as Latvia's minister of Economics and a Member of the European Parliament.

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2019 Jolo Cathedral bombing
events.summary: In the morning of January 27, 2019, two bombs exploded at the Roman Catholic Cathedral of Our Lady of Mount Carmel in Jolo, Sulu, Philippines. Twenty people were killed and 102 others injured. The bombings took place a week after the autonomy plebiscite held on January 21 for the creation of Bangsamoro.

events.title: 2019 Salvadoran presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in El Salvador on 3 February 2019, with Salvadorans electing the president and vice president for a five-year term from 2019 to 2024.

events.title: Battle: Battle of Baghuz Fawqani
events.summary: The Battle of Baghuz Fawqani was an offensive by the Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF), assisted by Combined Joint Task Force – Operation Inherent Resolve (CJTF-OIR) coalition airstrikes, artillery, and special forces personnel, that began on 9 February 2019 as part of the Deir ez-Zor campaign of the Syrian Civil War.

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2019 Pulwama attack
events.summary: The 2019 Pulwama attack occurred on 14 February 2019, when a convoy of vehicles carrying Indian security personnel on the Jammu–Srinagar National Highway was attacked by a vehicle-borne suicide bomber at Lethapora in the Pulwama district of the erstwhile state of Jammu and Kashmir.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Libya vs Forces of the House of Representatives
events.summary: UCDP records an internationalised civil conflict between Government of Libya and Forces of the House of Representatives (backed by Government of Sudan, Government of United Arab Emirates) over control of the government, starting 2019-02-21. This episode was active in 2 years (2019–2020), 1 of them at war level (1,000+ battle deaths a year), and ended 2020-10-31.

events.title: 2019 Cuban constitutional referendum
events.summary: A constitutional referendum was held in Cuba on 24 February 2019. Voters were asked whether they approved of a new constitution passed by the National Assembly of People's Power in July 2018. The reforms were approved, with 91% of valid votes cast in favour.

events.title: 2019 Okinawan referendum
events.summary: A referendum was held in Okinawa Prefecture on 24 February 2019. The referendum asked whether voters approved or opposed the landfill work at Henoko Bay for the construction of a new United States Marine Corps base. This is the second prefecture-wide referendum in Okinawa, the first being the 1996 referendum on the reduction of US military presence.

events.title: 2019 Moldovan referendum
events.summary: A non-binding two-part referendum was held in Moldova on 24 February 2019, alongside parliamentary elections. Voters were asked two questions; whether the number of MPs should be reduced from 101 to 61 and whether MPs should be open to recall. Both proposals were approved by voters, with voter turnout above the 33% threshold required to validate the result.

events.title: 2019 Moldovan parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Moldova on 24 February 2019 in order to elect the 101 members of the Parliament of Moldova. The Constitution holds that elections are to be held no later than four years and three months from the date of inauguration of the previous legislature.

events.title: 2019 Estonian parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Estonia on 3 March 2019. The newly elected 101 members of the 14th Riigikogu assembled at Toompea Castle in Tallinn within ten days of the election.

events.title: Terrorist attack: Christchurch mosque shootings
events.summary: On 15 March 2019, two consecutive terrorist mass shootings took place in Christchurch, New Zealand. They were committed during Friday prayer, first at the Al Noor Mosque in Riccarton at 1:40 p.m., and shortly afterwards at 1:52 p.m. at the Linwood Islamic Centre. In total, 51 people were killed and 89 others were injured, including 40 by gunfire.

events.title: 2019 Tristan da Cunha general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Tristan da Cunha on 26 March 2019 to elect eight members of the Island Council and the Chief Islander.

events.title: 2019 Slovak presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in Slovakia in March 2019. Incumbent President Andrej Kiska did not run for a second term.

events.title: 2019 Maltese presidential election
events.summary: The 2019 Maltese presidential election took place on 2 April 2019. Members of the Parliament of Malta voted in an indirect election to approve the appointment of former cabinet minister George Vella, the only nominee, as President of Malta.

events.title: 2019 Andorran parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Andorra on 7 April 2019, electing all 28 seats of the General Council. Although they remained the largest party, the Democrats for Andorra lost their parliamentary majority after losing four seats. The Social Democratic Party gained four seats, becoming the second-largest party.

events.title: April 2019 Israeli legislative election
events.summary: Early legislative elections were held in Israel on 9 April 2019 to elect the 120 members of the 21st Knesset. Elections had been due in November 2019, but were brought forward following a dispute between members of the current government over a bill on Haredi conscription, as well as impending corruption charges against incumbent prime minister Benjamin…

events.title: Coup: 2019 Sudanese coup d'état
events.summary: A coup d'état overthrew President Omar al-Bashir and his three-decade authoritarian regime in Sudan on 11 April 2019, after months of widespread popular protests demanding his departure.

events.title: 2019 Finnish parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Finland on 14 April 2019. For the first time, no party received more than 20% of the vote. The Centre Party, which had been the largest party following the 2015 elections, dropped to fourth place, losing 18 seats and recording its lowest vote share since 1917.

events.title: 2019 North Macedonian presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in North Macedonia in 2019. Three candidates were on the ballot in the first round, held on 21 April: Stevo Pendarovski, supported by the ruling coalition led by the Social Democratic Union of Macedonia, including the Democratic Union for Integration; Gordana Siljanovska-Davkova of the leading opposition party VMRO-DPMNE,…

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2019 Sri Lanka bombings
events.summary: On 21 April 2019, Easter Sunday, three churches in Sri Lanka and three luxury hotels in the commercial capital, Colombo, were targeted in a series of coordinated Islamic State (IS)-related terrorist suicide bombings. Later that day, two smaller explosions occurred at a housing complex in Dematagoda and a guest house in Dehiwala.

events.title: 2019 Ukrainian presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in Ukraine on 31 March 2019. As none of the 39 candidates on the ballot received an absolute majority of the initial vote, a runoff was held on 21 April between the top two vote-getters: Volodymyr Zelenskyy, a television personality, and Petro Poroshenko, the incumbent president.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Cameroon vs IS (Islamic State)
events.summary: UCDP records an internationalised civil conflict between Government of Cameroon (backed by Government of Chad) and IS over control of Islamic State, starting 2019-04-27. This episode was active in 1 year (2019–2019), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year), and ended 2019-09-17.

events.title: April 2019 Spanish general election
events.summary: A general election was held in Spain on 28 April 2019 to elect the members of the 13th Cortes Generales under the Spanish Constitution of 1978. All 350 seats in the Congress of Deputies were up for election, as well as 208 of 266 seats in the Senate. It was held concurrently with a regional election in the Valencian Community.

events.title: 2019 Lithuanian presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in Lithuania on 12 May 2019, with a second round held on 26 May 2019. Due to a constitutional limit of two terms in office, incumbent president Dalia Grybauskaitė was unable to run, having won the 2009 and 2014 elections.

events.title: 2019 Panamanian general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Panama on 5 May 2019. Due to constitutional term limits, incumbent President Juan Carlos Varela was ineligible for a second consecutive term.

events.title: 2019 Belizean territorial dispute referendum
events.summary: A referendum on the territorial dispute with Guatemala was held in Belize on 8 May 2019. Voters were asked whether the territorial dispute with neighbouring Guatemala should be referred to the International Court of Justice.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Pakistan vs BRAS (Balochistan)
events.summary: UCDP records a civil conflict between Government of Pakistan and BRAS over control of Balochistan, starting 2019-05-11. This episode was active in 7 years (2019–2025), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year) and was still active in the latest data.

events.title: 2019 Lithuanian constitutional referendum
events.summary: A constitutional referendum was held in Lithuania on 12 May 2019, alongside the first round of the presidential elections.

events.title: Volodymyr Zelenskyy takes power
events.summary: Volodymyr Oleksandrovych Zelenskyy is a Ukrainian politician and former entertainer who has served as the sixth president of Ukraine since 2019.

events.title: Thirty-eighth Amendment of the Constitution of Ireland
events.summary: The Thirty-eighth Amendment of the Constitution of Ireland is an amendment to the Constitution of Ireland which altered the provisions regulating divorce. It removed the constitutional requirement for a defined period of separation before a Court may grant a dissolution of marriage, and eased restrictions on the recognition of foreign divorces.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Rwanda vs FDLR-FOCA, FDLR-RUD, RMDC
events.summary: UCDP records an internationalised civil conflict between Government of Rwanda (backed by Government of DR Congo (Zaire)) and FDLR-FOCA, FDLR-RUD, RMDC over control of the government, starting 2019-05-25. This episode was active in 2 years (2019–2020), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year), and ended 2020-12-30.

events.title: 2019 Belgian federal election
events.summary: Federal elections were held in Belgium on 26 May 2019, alongside the country's European and regional elections. All 150 members of the Chamber of Representatives were elected from eleven multi-member constituencies.

events.title: 2019 Romanian referendum
events.summary: A consultative referendum took place in Romania on 26 May 2019, on the same day as the European Parliament elections, about whether to prohibit amnesties and pardons for corruption offences, as well as whether to prohibit the Government from passing emergency ordinances concerning the judiciary and to extend the right to appeal against them to the…

events.title: 2019 Dutch Senate election
events.summary: The 2019 election to the Senate of the Netherlands was held on 27 May 2019, two months after the provincial elections.

events.title: Hartwig Löger takes power
events.summary: Hartwig Löger is an Austrian politician and former business executive who served as minister of finance from 2017 to 2019. From 2011 to 2017 he was chief executive officer of UNIQA Austria.

events.title: 2019 Latvian presidential election
events.summary: Indirect presidential elections were held in Latvia on 29 May 2019.

events.title: Nayib Bukele takes power
events.summary: Nayib Armando Bukele Ortez is a Salvadoran politician who has served as the 43rd president of El Salvador since 2019.

events.title: Assassination: assassination of Walter Lübcke
events.summary: On the night of 1–2 June 2019, German politician Walter Lübcke, the Regierungspräsident of the Kassel region, was assassinated at his home in Wolfhagen-Istha, Hesse, Germany. Lübcke was found dead from a gunshot to the head by his son a few hours after his murder.

events.title: 2019 San Marino referendum
events.summary: Two referendums were held in San Marino on 2 June 2019. The first was a popular initiative on amending the electoral system to require a second round between the top two parties to be held thirty days after general elections if neither party is able to form a coalition government.

events.title: Brigitte Bierlein takes power
events.summary: Brigitte Bierlein was an Austrian jurist who served as President of the Constitutional Court from 2018 to 2019 and as Chancellor of Austria from 2019 to 2020. An independent, she was the first woman to hold either office.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Somalia vs IS (Islamic State)
events.summary: UCDP records an internationalised civil conflict between Government of Somalia (backed by Government of United States of America) and IS over control of Islamic State, starting 2019-06-04. This episode was active in 3 years (2019–2021), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year), and ended 2021-12-19.

events.title: Antti Rinne takes power
events.summary: Antti Juhani Rinne is a Finnish politician who served as speaker of the Parliament of Finland from April to June 2019 and Prime Minister of Finland from June to December 2019. He led the Social Democratic Party from 2014 until 2020. In August 2023, he was hired as the General Secretary of SAMAK for a three-year term.

events.title: 9811205000 takes power
events.summary: Kyriakos Mitsotakis is a Greek politician, and the prime minister of Greece since July 2019, except for a month between May and June 2023. Mitsotakis has been president of the New Democracy party since 2016. He is generally associated with the centre-right, espousing economically liberal policies.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Ethiopia vs Military faction (forces of Asaminew Tsige) (Amhara)
events.summary: UCDP records a civil conflict between Government of Ethiopia and Military faction (forces of Asaminew Tsige) over control of Amhara, starting 2019-06-22. This episode was active in 1 year (2019–2019), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year), and ended 2019-06-24.

events.title: Coup: 2019 Amhara Region coup d'état attempt
events.summary: The 2019 Amhara Region coup d'état attempt was an attempted coup d'état against the Amhara Regional government on 22 June 2019, during which factions of the Amhara Region's Peace and Security Bureau assassinated the Amhara Regional President Ambachew Mekonnen.

events.title: Mette Frederiksen takes power
events.summary: Mette Frederiksen is a Danish politician who has served as the prime minister of Denmark since 2019 and the leader of the Social Democrats since 2015. She is the second woman to hold either office following Helle Thorning-Schmidt, and is also the youngest prime minister in Danish history.

events.title: Laurentino Cortizo takes power
events.summary: Laurentino "Nito" Cortizo Cohen is a Panamanian politician who served as the 38th President of Panama from 2019 to 2024. Previously, he served as President of the National Assembly (2000–2001) and Minister of Agricultural and Livestock Development (2004–2006). Cortizo was a member of the National Assembly for Colón Province from 1994 to 2004.

events.title: 2019 Greek parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Greece on 7 July 2019. The elections were called by Prime Minister Alexis Tsipras on 26 May 2019 after the ruling Syriza party lost the European and local elections. They were the first national elections since the voting age was lowered to 17, and the number of parliamentary constituencies was increased from 56 to 59.

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2019 Yuen Long attack
events.summary: A mob attack occurred in Yuen Long, a town in the New Territories of Hong Kong, on the evening of 21 July 2019. It took place in the context of the 2019–2020 Hong Kong protests. A mob dressed in white stormed the MTR's Yuen Long station and attacked protesters returning from a demonstration in Sheung Wan on Hong Kong Island as well as bystanders.

events.title: 2019 Ukrainian parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Ukraine on 21 July 2019. Originally scheduled to be held at the end of October, the elections were brought forward after newly inaugurated President Volodymyr Zelenskyy dissolved parliament on 21 May 2019, during his inauguration.

events.title: Boris Johnson takes power
events.summary: Alexander Boris de Pfeffel Johnson is a British politician and writer who was Prime Minister of the United Kingdom and Leader of the Conservative Party from 2019 to 2022. He was previously Foreign Secretary from 2016 to 2018 and Mayor of London from 2008 to 2016.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: United States of America vs al-Qaida
events.summary: UCDP records an internationalised civil conflict between Government of United States of America (backed by Government of Afghanistan) and al-Qaida  over control of the government, starting 2019-07-31. This episode was active in 1 year (2019–2019), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year), and ended 2019-09-07.

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2019 El Paso shooting
events.summary: On August 3, 2019, a mass shooting occurred at a Walmart store in El Paso, Texas, United States. The gunman, 21-year-old Patrick Crusius, shot 45 people, killing 23 and injuring 22 others. The Federal Bureau of Investigation investigated the shooting as an act of domestic terrorism and a hate crime.

events.title: Terrorist attack: August 2019 Kabul bombing
events.summary: A suicide car bomb exploded at a security checkpoint outside a police station in the Afghanistan capital, Kabul, on 7 August 2019. The explosion occurred in the early morning, in a predominantly Shia neighbourhood in western Kabul. At least 14 people were killed and 145 injured, mostly civilians.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Mozambique vs IS (Islamic State)
events.summary: UCDP records a civil conflict between Government of Mozambique and IS over control of Islamic State, starting 2019-08-07. This episode was active in 7 years (2019–2025), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year) and was still active in the latest data.

events.title: 2018 Czech Senate election
events.summary: Senate elections were held in the Czech Republic on 5 and 6 October 2018 alongside municipal elections, with a second round held on 12 and 13 October 2018. The Conservative Civic Democratic Party (ODS) won the election with 10 seats. Governing parties ANO 2011 and the Czech Social Democratic Party were heavily defeated, winning only 1 seat each.

events.title: Terrorist attack: 17 August 2019 Kabul bombing
events.summary: On 17 August 2019, a suicide bombing took place during a wedding in a wedding hall in Kabul, Afghanistan. At least 92 people were killed in the attack and over 140 injured. The Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant claimed responsibility for the bombing, stating that the attack targeted the Shi'ites.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Burkina Faso vs IS (Islamic State)
events.summary: UCDP records an internationalised civil conflict between Government of Burkina Faso (backed by Government of France) and IS over control of Islamic State, starting 2019-08-19. This episode was active in 7 years (2019–2025), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year) and was still active in the latest data.

events.title: Natural disaster: Hurricane Dorian
events.summary: Hurricane Dorian was an extremely powerful and catastrophic tropical cyclone, which became the most intense on record to strike the Bahamas. It is tied with the 1935 Labor Day hurricane and Hurricane Melissa in 2025 for the strongest landfall in the Atlantic basin in terms of maximum sustained winds.

events.title: Giorgi Gakharia takes power
events.summary: Giorgi Gakharia is a Georgian politician who served as the 14th Prime Minister of Georgia from 8 September 2019 until his resignation on 18 February 2021.

events.title: September 2019 Israeli legislative election
events.summary: Legislative elections were held in Israel on 17 September 2019 to elect the 120 members of the 22nd Knesset. Following the previous elections in April, incumbent Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu failed to form a governing coalition.

events.title: 2019 Austrian legislative election
events.summary: Legislative elections were held in Austria on 29 September 2019 to elect the 27th National Council, the lower house of Austria's bicameral parliament.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Ethiopia vs OLA (Oromiya)
events.summary: UCDP records a civil conflict between Government of Ethiopia and OLA over control of Oromiya, starting 2019-10-06. This episode was active in 7 years (2019–2025), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year) and was still active in the latest data.

events.title: 2019 Kosovan parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Kosovo on 6 October 2019. The main opposition parties received the most votes, led by Vetëvendosje and the Democratic League of Kosovo (LDK). Vetëvendosje leader Albin Kurti became Prime Minister, forming a governing coalition with the LDK on an anti-corruption platform.

events.title: 2019 Portuguese legislative election
events.summary: The 2019 Portuguese legislative election was held on 6 October 2019. All 230 seats to the Assembly of the Republic were contested.

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2019 Halle synagogue shooting
events.summary: On 9 October 2019, 27-year-old neo-Nazi Stephan Balliet attempted to enter a synagogue in Halle, Saxony-Anhalt, Germany, during the Jewish holiday of Yom Kippur. After failing to gain entry, Balliet opened fire at two people nearby, killing a woman, before driving to a nearby Turkish kebab shop where he opened fire again and killed a customer of the store.

events.title: 2019 Polish parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Poland on 13 October 2019. All 460 members of the Sejm and 100 senators of the Senate were elected. The ruling right-wing Law and Justice (PiS) won re-election to a second term retaining its majority in the Sejm. However, it lost its majority in the Senate to the opposition.

events.title: 2019 Swiss federal election
events.summary: Federal elections were held in Switzerland on 20 October 2019 to elect all members of both houses of the Federal Assembly. This was followed by the 2019 election to the Swiss Federal Council, the federal executive, by the United Federal Assembly.

events.title: 2019 Canadian federal election
events.summary: The 2019 Canadian federal election was held on October 21, 2019. Members of the House of Commons were elected to the 43rd Canadian Parliament. In keeping with the maximum four-year term under a 2007 amendment to the Canada Elections Act, the writs of election for the 2019 election were issued by Governor General Julie Payette on September 11, 2019.

events.title: Sophie Wilmès takes power
events.summary: Sophie Wilmès is a Belgian politician who served as the prime minister of Belgium from 2019 to 2020. She later served as minister of foreign affairs from 2020 to 2022. A member of the Reformist Movement, she is the first woman to hold either position.

events.title: November 2019 Spanish general election
events.summary: A general election was held in Spain on 10 November 2019 to elect the members of the 14th Cortes Generales under the Spanish Constitution of 1978. All 350 seats in the Congress of Deputies were up for election, as well as 208 of 265 seats in the Senate.

events.title: Pandemic: COVID-19 pandemic
events.summary: The global COVID-19 pandemic, caused by severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), began with an outbreak in Wuhan, China, in December 2019. It spread to other parts of Asia and then worldwide in early 2020.

events.title: 2019 Belarusian parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Belarus on 17 November 2019.

events.title: 2019 Liechtenstein hospital referendum
events.summary: A referendum on the financing of a new public hospital in Vaduz was held in Liechtenstein on 24 November 2019. The proposal was approved by 56% of voters.

events.title: 2019 Romanian presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in Romania on 10 November 2019, with a second round held on 24 November 2019. They were the eighth presidential election held in post-1989 Romania. Incumbent president Klaus Iohannis, first elected in the 2014 election, was eligible for re-election.

events.title: Earthquake: 2019 Albania earthquake
events.summary: On 26 November 2019 at 03:54 CET (UTC+1), northwestern Albania was struck by a magnitude 6.4 earthquake with an epicentre 16 kilometres (9.9 mi) west-southwest of Mamurras.

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2019 London Bridge stabbing
events.summary: On 29 November 2019, five people were stabbed, two of them fatally, in Central London. The attacker, Usman Khan, was fatally shot by City of London Police.

events.title: Zoran Tegeltija takes power
events.summary: Zoran Tegeltija is a Bosnian Serb politician serving as director of the Indirect Taxation Authority of Bosnia and Herzegovina (ITA) since June 2023. He previously served as Minister of Finance and Treasury from January to June 2023. He also served as Chairman of the Council of Ministers of Bosnia and Herzegovina from 2019 to 2023.

events.title: 2019 Dominican general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Dominica on 6 December 2019. The elections were constitutionally due by March 2020, but had been widely expected to take place before the end of 2019. The result was a landslide victory for the ruling Dominica Labour Party, which won 18 of the 21 elected seats, gaining three seats.

events.title: 2019 San Marino general election
events.summary: General elections were held in San Marino on 8 December 2019.

events.title: Sanna Marin takes power
events.summary: Sanna Mirella Marin is a Finnish politician who served as prime minister of Finland from 2019 to 2023 and as the leader of the Social Democratic Party of Finland (SDP) from 2020 to 2023. She was a Member of Parliament from 2015 to 2023.

events.title: 2019 United Kingdom general election
events.summary: A general election was held in the United Kingdom on 12 December 2019, with 47,074,800 registered voters entitled to vote to elect 650 Members of Parliament (MPs) to the House of Commons.

events.title: Terrorist attack: December 2019 Mogadishu bombing
events.summary: On 28 December 2019, a suicide truck bomber killed at least 85 people at the Ex-Control Afgoye police checkpoint in Mogadishu, Somalia. More than 140 others were wounded and, as of 31 December, 12 people remained missing. Al-Shabaab claimed responsibility for the attack on 30 December.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Angola vs FLEC-FAC-TN (Cabinda)
events.summary: UCDP records a civil conflict between Government of Angola and FLEC-FAC-TN over control of Cabinda, starting 2019-12-31. This episode was active in 2 years (2019–2020), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year), and ended 2020-12-31.
